notes.title: September Update
notes.notes:
September Update:


 Level lighting has been revised
 Added reflections for metallic surfaces.
 The background scene for the main menu was reworked.
 Bugfix: the pop-up player panel has been adjusted so that the flicker/jump bug no longer occurs. 
 On the map Ruinaro there is now a new skybox that fits better to the lighting.
 Screen space reflections have been enabled on all floors of all walkable houses.
